Description: Triggers invoice generation via Payment Service. HTTP endpoint that delegates to InvoiceService.generateInvoice(). Same logic as the cron job but triggered manually.
Criticality Reason: Manual trigger for invoice generation. Calls Payment Service with Basic Auth. Financial operation.
Sensitive Data: Yes — Basic Auth credentials sent to Payment Service.
Dependencies: External: Payment Service (GET /api/invoices/generate with Basic Auth). Uses AxiosService.
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs start, success, error details (status, headers, body).
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no metrics. No request tracking. No auth — public endpoint triggering financial operation.
Notes: SECURITY: No auth on manual invoice trigger. Shares logic with cron job. Basic Auth credentials in env vars.

Description: Sends pending loan applications to Minecofin/RIM banks. Fetches applications with status=Pending, isSentToBank=false, membershipStatus=ACTIVE, accountNumber not null. Authenticates with Access Control Service. Routes to MinecofinLoanGateway or RimLoanGateway based on bankClassification. On success marks isSentToBank=true, integrationStatus=SUBMITTED. On 'EXIST' error creates CON_ERR status record.
Criticality Reason: Core loan submission pipeline. Sends loan requests to external banking systems (Minecofin SACCOs, RIM). Failure means loans stuck in pending state. Financial transactions at stake.
Important Log Fields: applications_count, applications_sent, applications_failed, bank_classification, job_duration_ms, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Yes — loan amounts, account numbers, bank codes sent to external systems.
Dependencies: DB: Application.findAll(status=Pending, isSentToBank=false), Application.update(isSentToBank, integrationStatus, externalId), ApplicationBankStatus.create(). External: Access Control Service (login for token), Minecofin API (via MinecofinLoanGateway), RIM API (via RimLoanGateway). Redis: Token caching (5min TTL).
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs application count, per-application send, errors. console.log for response data.
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but uses console.log. No metrics. No per-bank breakdown. No submission latency tracking. No access control auth failure alerting. Promise.all without error isolation — one failure doesn't stop others but errors may be swallowed.
Notes: CRITICAL: Financial loan submissions. Promise.all may swallow individual errors. Uses console.log instead of structured logging. Cron configurable via env var.

Description: Polls SACCO loan status from Minecofin via Access Control Service. Processes bank-by-bank using StatusJobs to track progress. Matches API status data to pending applications by referenceNumber. Updates ApplicationBankStatus and Application records. On DISBURSED: sets status=Approved, updates BankInfo balance/disbursedAmount. On REJECTED: sets status=Rejected. Uses Sequelize transactions.
Criticality Reason: Loan lifecycle tracking. Status transitions (SUBMITTED→DISBURSED/REJECTED) drive business outcomes. Balance updates on disbursement affect financial accounting. Transaction integrity critical.
Important Log Fields: pending_applications_count, status_records_received, statuses_processed, disbursements_count, rejections_count, bank_code, job_duration_ms, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Yes — loan amounts, account balances, disbursement amounts.
Dependencies: DB: BankInfo.findAll(), StatusJobs.findOne/create(), Application.findAll(status=Pending), ApplicationBankStatus.create(), Application.update(), BankInfo.update(balance, disbursedAmount) in transaction. External: Access Control Service (login + loan-status API).
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs start, application count, per-application processing, DISBURSED/REJECTED transitions. console.log for job data.
Observability Gap: Has decent logging but uses console.log. No metrics for status transitions. No balance change tracking. No disbursement amount tracking. StatusJobs provides basic job tracking but no alerting.
Notes: CRITICAL: Financial status transitions. BankInfo.balance updated with sequelize.literal (SQL injection risk if principalAmount not sanitized). StatusJobs table tracks job execution but no monitoring on it.

Description: Polls RIM bank loan status. Fetches pending RIM applications. Gets status per-application from Access Control Service RIM endpoint. Maps stages (UNDER_REVIEW, REJECTED, APPROVED, DISBURSED). Deduplicates status entries. Updates ApplicationBankStatus and Application via updateStatusData().
Criticality Reason: RIM bank loan lifecycle tracking. Same criticality as SACCO polling. Status transitions drive business outcomes.
Important Log Fields: pending_applications_count, statuses_processed, duplicates_skipped, bank=rim, job_duration_ms, trace_id
Dependencies: DB: Application.findAll(status=Pending, bankClassification=RIM), ApplicationBankStatus.findOne (dedup check), ApplicationBankStatus.create(), Application.update(). External: Access Control Service (login + RIM loan-status API).
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs application count, no-data cases, per-application processing, duplicate detection.
Observability Gap: Has basic logging. No metrics. No status transition tracking. Per-application API calls — could be slow with many pending.
Notes: Per-application API call (no batch). Could be slow with many pending applications. Deduplication logic prevents duplicate status entries.

Description: Daily reconciliation for missed SACCO loan statuses. Groups pending applications by bankCode. Calls Minecofin status API per bank. Identifies applications without status (missed). Retries sending missed applications (max retries from MISSED_RETRY_COUNT env, default 3). Auto-rejects applications exceeding retry limit. Handles 'EXIST' error cases. For applications with status, processes via transaction (same as saccoLoanStatus). Sleeps 5s between bank codes.
Criticality Reason: Financial reconciliation. Catches loans that fell through cracks. Auto-rejection after max retries is business decision. Wrong reconciliation = wrong financial state.
Important Log Fields: pending_count, missed_count, retried_count, auto_rejected_count, resolved_count, bank_code, job_duration_ms, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Yes — loan amounts, account numbers, bank data.
Dependencies: DB: Application.findAll(status=Pending, SACCO), ApplicationBankStatus.findAll/create(), Application.update(), BankInfo.findOne/update(). External: Access Control Service (login + loan-status + loan-request APIs). Redis: Token caching.
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs missed applications with IDs, retry attempts, reconciliation steps. console.log for errors and debug.
Observability Gap: Has decent logging but uses console.log. No reconciliation metrics. No auto-rejection alerting. No retry count tracking. sleep(5000) between banks is unmonitored.
Notes: CRITICAL: Auto-rejects loans after max retries. console.log in catch blocks. sleep(5000) between bank codes. .then/.catch pattern mixed with async/await.

Authentication: N/A — internal scheduled job (delegates auth to application-service)
Criticality Reason: GFA document generation trigger. Legal document. Failure means pending GFAs not generated.
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs start, URL, success, error details (status, headers, response body truncated to 500 chars). console.error for errors.
Observability Gap: Has good error logging but no metrics. No generation count tracking. No alerting on failure.
Notes: Delegates to application-service. console.error mixed with logger. Error logging includes response headers (potential info leak in logs).

Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in). Logs start, URL, success, error details. console.error for errors.

Notes: Same cron schedule as GFA — both run at minute 45. May cause load spike on application-service.
